blender.summary: Editable 3D scenes, keyframes and Geometry Nodes; background Eevee/Cycles previews and animations. Poly Haven asset acquisition with provenance.

voice.summary: Speech synthesis and voice cloning on MLX. Usable on its own as a voice tool; knows nothing about episodes or pipelines.

fal-media.summary: Tracked image and video generation jobs against fal.ai, with provenance and cost. Video is MiniMax H3.

codex-image.summary: Image generation and editing through an OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex subscription, or the Images API. A second provider for image.generate, billed against a plan rather than per image.

graphics.summary: Deterministic SVG/PNG rendering of code frames, diagrams, callouts and titles.

terminal-recorder.summary: Records a terminal session to video from a VHS tape. Useful on its own; knows nothing about episodes.

infographics.summary: Frame-accurate animated infographics rendered through Remotion.

video-composer.summary: Compiles a typed edit timeline into an FFmpeg filter graph; probes and QAs the result.

remotion-composer.summary: Renders a layered, kit-based edit timeline (studio.video/v1alpha2) with Remotion, then normalises loudness with FFmpeg. A second provider for video.compose.

contracts.summary: Canonical schemas, vocabulary and bindings. Every other studio piece depends on it.

series.summary: Series compilers: a pinned episode spec and its measured narration, compiled into an edit timeline.

episode.summary: An episode on disk, produced: its edit timeline built or compiled from its spec, checked against its series' rules, rendered.

runtime.summary: Deterministic pipeline state: snapshots, leases, staleness, journal, policy.

pipelines.summary: Built-in pipeline manifests for the shared narrated-video path.

adapters.summary: Stage adapters: declarative descriptors pairing a pipeline stage's contracts and capability with the code that performs it. What the gateway dispatches to.

agent.summary: The Pi executive-producer package: tools, commands, stage UX. This is where studio-specific integration with the reusable packages lives.

gateway.summary: Local backend owning Pi RPC processes and streaming events to the browser.

web.summary: Browser studio for reviewing artifacts, attempts and deliverables.
